items.why: The fear gauge is spiking as headlines warn of an AI bust risk if the boom disappoints, with the major indexes all dropping.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Shares fall as reports say Jensen Huang is weighing a CEO comeback, with Musk backing a return, ahead of Nvidia earnings.
Big tech is sliding as the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq drop ahead of a pivotal week for AI.

market_note: Nasdaq futures are down about 1.9% and the S&P future is down about 1.2%, with oil slipping and the VIX up sharply.
summary: Stocks are sharply lower Monday midday, with tech and AI names leading the slide. The VIX is spiking as investors brace for a pivotal week for AI and Nvidia earnings.
